main_text.p: fet, qui argumentaretur Zuinglius dicit, Caluinus scripsit, Lutherus docuit, Hottingerus insanit, alius quispiam ineptit. Ergo Ecclesia Occidentalis dicit, scripsit, docuit, insanit, ineptit . Licet enim, ple-rique prauarum religionum virus spargant, pestiferas de dogmate opiniones disseminent, Pontificiam Ecclesiam impugnent, & tandem noxijs moribus labem, & vulnus conscientiæ infligant, Ecclesia tamen Pontificia nunquam de præeminentia, nunquam de dignitate, nunquam de infallibilitate, sua decidit, sed quo pluribus perfecu-tionum turbis, Hæreticorum machinis, male sanorum hominum fraudibus concutitur, plus plusque candido lumine claret, exacta ad omnem legem innocentia augescit, in-

page.notes: The first word "fet," is a fragment from the previous page and is kept as printed. The catchword "in-" is taken from the foot of the page. Long s has been transcribed as plain s throughout. Reading of "diffeminent" as "disseminent" and "fanorum" as "sanorum" follows the long-s convention.
